name: preview-card-1i
title: Preview Card 1i: Stacked variants
author: tony <tony@spaceman.sh>
description: A catalogue card for showing a live component preview. Faint card edges peek out behind the card, hinting that there are more variants inside.
docs: Every preview card design exports the same `PreviewCard` component, so you can switch designs by changing the import path. Pass the live preview as children.
